title: Scalar-extension pullback from R to A with coefficient and root-tensor endpoints
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$ with $\ell$ invertible and a morphism $f:X\to Y$. Use normalized Chern data $c_Y,c_X$ [def-sp-tower-class-chern], normalized geometric tower data $b,g$ with derived $A$-module inverse image $P_A$ [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], and the section-normalized coefficient and line comparisons $\theta_0,\theta_1$ [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal, def-sp-tower-class-pullback]. There exist intermediate integral-coefficient pullback data $d=(P_R,\beta,e_0,e_1,k)$ [def-sp-tower-chern-pullback-intermediate] and a natural transformation $\kappa:S_YP_A\to P_R^DS_X$, where $S_T$ is the recorded derived scalar extension $R_T\to A_T$, such that $\kappa_{R_Y}S_X(e_0^D)u_X=P_A(u_Y)\theta_0$ and $\kappa_{M_Y[2]}S_X(e_1^D(2))v_X=P_A(v_Y)\mathrm{shift}_{P_A}(2)\theta_1[2]$. Here $u_T:S_TR_T\simeq A_T$ is the normalized scalar unit and $v_T:S_T(M_T[2])\to\mathrm{line}_T[2]$ is scalarRootTarget. Compositions are left to right. Neither equation involves the integral reduction functors or their integral-unit and Kummer-boundary identifications.

lean.statement:
theorem tower_chernScalar_pullback
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (_hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(X, ⊤))) (_hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E) (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f)
    (cY : Chern l E Y) (cX : Chern l E X)
    (_nY : cY.Normalized l E) (_nX : cX.Normalized l E)
    (θ₀ : CoefficientPullback l E b f g) (θ₁ : LinePullback l E f g cY cX) :
    ∃ d : IntegralCoefficientPullback l E f cY cX,
    ∃ κ : cY.scalar.T ⋙ SpTowerShriek.pull l E b g ⟶
        d.pull.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ cX.scalar.T,
      κ.app (unit Y (Rrings l Y)) ≫ cX.scalar.T.map d.derivedUnit.hom ≫
          cX.scalarUnit.hom =
        (SpTowerShriek.pull l E b g).map cY.scalarUnit.hom ≫
          (θ₀.derivedIso l E).hom ∧
      κ.app (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems Y (Rrings l Y)) 0).obj
          cY.rootModule)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ≫
          cX.scalar.T.map (d.derivedRoot 2).hom ≫ scalarRootTarget cX =
        (SpTowerShriek.pull l E b g).map (scalarRootTarget cY) ≫
          ((SpTowerShriek.pull l E b g).commShiftIso (2 : ℤ)).hom.app (line l E cY) ≫
          ((θ₁.derivedIso l E).hom)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧'
